news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹48.77 (up from ₹36.43 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹92.2b (up 17% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹9.24b (up 36% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 10.0% (up from 8.6% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 7.0%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹12.16 (up from ₹8.12 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹23.7b (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.31b (up 50% from 3Q 2025). Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 13%. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India.
